text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I really can't beat you at arm wrestling, huh~
Kawakami-san, you're way too strong.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
As a princess, this much arm strength is a given!
Now then, who is my next opponent!?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is this an arm-wrestling contest?
Allow me to join in as well.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hmph...!! Grrrgh!
N-Not bad at all... Kawakami!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
N-No, Pearl-san, you're the one...! Ngggh!
—Khhh! To think you could go toe-to-toe with me...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait, both of you, stooop!
The floor's making weird noises, no more!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*... To think she's this good...
Just what kind of training has she been doing...?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*... I put the 'power transfer'
Trainer taught me right into practice!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
For example, even during strength training, I focus
on form over reps to improve the quality of each set!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Fufu, thanks to you, look at me now! As expected, Trainer, you truly are the finest pearl that brings out my shine!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh my! Does this mean
I will become even stronger!?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Trainer and I have no limits!
We're gonna aim even higher~!!
